Introduction
This document outlines the 
inspection checklist I1 for Auma actuator valve type SAREX 10.1 F10, K.K.S 
PGM10.AA005 & PGM10.AA006, to be carried out on an annually 
bases as indicated as indicated by 
Y1 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Zakaria Mohamed Abdel Raheem, reviewied & yested by eng. 
 Osama Ahmed Hasanian, accepted by general director eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman 
Selim, and approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel Bast head Sector of Aswan Dam 2 
Hydraulic Power Station and certified by HPGC quality control general director, 
and MPIS coordinator eng. Kamel Ragheb.
Safety 
Precautions
A work order 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
Ensure the unit out of service
Close manual isolating valves after and before 
 control valve.
Disconnect power 
 supply.
Disconnect the 
 mechanical coupling
Tools and Equipments
Safety helmet, 
 shoes, and rags
Digital Ammeter, Screw Driver.
Open end Spanner set.
DC Power Supply.
Work to be carried out
Steps to Prepare for test
Review 
 technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Obtain copy 
 of valve field maintenance file.
Testing 
Procedure
Put Operation selector switch to manual position.
Open valve manually and record the opening 
 indicator lamp and the digital signal as in signal list.
Close valve manually and record the closing 
 indicator lamp and the digital signal as in signal list.
Simulate the Failure signal and check the failure 
 indicator lamp and alarm signal.
Return Control Valve to 
Service
Return control valve to service by reconnecting the mechanical 
 coupling.
Connect power supply.
Open manual isolating valves.
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance.
